Did the US just violate the Iran ceasefire?

In the wake of the US reportedly firing at and seizing an Iranian-flagged
cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz, join **Mehdi** and **Prem** to break down
this escalation, and all the latest from this war.

Tune into 'Ask the Editor:' a live Q&A on **Monday** at **11am ET, 8am PT, or
4pm GMT**. **Zeteo** subscribers can join the conversation on
